title: orobanche cooperi subsp. palmeri
intro: Orobanche cooperi subsp. palmeri, commonly known as Palmer's broomrape or Palmer's broom-rape, is a parasitic plant species that belongs to the family Orobanchaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as fever, digestive issues, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Orobanche cooperi subsp. palmeri are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antibacterial and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
